name: [D1] Tighten lifecycle assertions and restore source size limits (M)
description:
Tighten lifecycle assertions and restore source size limits

Location: src/ovcaq/runtime/supervisor.py; tests/runtime/test_supervisor_cli.py; tests/state/test_cli.py

Reuse: existing StateStore/StateService, pure decisions, shared runtime ownership and test fixtures.

Contract (source requirement/design excerpts):
`run` requires `--no-tui` in this PRD and owns the foreground process.
ovcaq capability retry NAME
R12: Function sizes respect the 50-line limit.
R13: File sizes respect the 800-line limit.

Details:
Extract focused timeout-observation and metric-finalization helpers without changing lifecycle behavior; bring _collect and _conclude below the 50-line AST limit. Move the touched parser-inventory test to the lifecycle CLI test module so tests/state/test_cli.py returns below 800 lines without changing unrelated tests. Strengthen incomplete command tests to distinguish a recognized run command missing --no-tui and capability retry missing NAME from an unknown command; the revised cases must fail against the work base. Do not rewrite the unrelated pre-existing config-collision test (F19 discarded).

It pins neither `run` requiring `--no-tui` nor `capability retry` requiring NAME (fail-first replay) | File: tests/runtime/test_supervisor_cli.py:111 | Consensus: [1/3]
- ⚪ tests/state/test_cli.py is 812 lines (807 at base); this diff grows a file already over the 800-line cap | File: tests/state/test_cli.py | Consensus: [1/3]
